title: Tunisian Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African dish inspired by Indian spices. Marinated chicken cooked in a rich and spicy tomato-based sauce.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs
chicken tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and allspice

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken and set aside. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Stir in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return chicken to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in chicken tagine spice blend and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot over wholesome rice or with tunisian flatbread.
